title: Saudi-Arabian Chicken Bowl
description: A nutrient-dense, umami, and energizing Saudi-Arabian dish featuring jasmine rice and crispy chicken in a stone bowl.
instructions: Heat a large stone bowl or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ghee or oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, and crushed red pepper. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the jasmine rice to the bowl and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the bowl and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the bowl with a lid, and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Return the chicken to the bowl and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken and rice in the stone bowl, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
